audit.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
canonical=json.loads((root/'docs/evidence/2026-09-10-v1-05c2d2-native-pre-script-supervision.json').read_bytes())
assert canonical['whole_v1_complete'] is False
for item in canonical['references']:
    assert sha((root/item['path']).read_bytes())==item['sha256'],item['path']
inventory=json.loads((root/canonical['inventory']['path']).read_bytes())
epoch=inventory['final_epoch'];counts={}
for name,folder,commit in [('core',root,canonical['code_commit']),('pro',root.parent/'orze-pro',inventory['pro_source_commit'])]:
    assert epoch['pre'][name]==epoch['post'][name]
    rawpaths=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-c','-o','--exclude-standard','-z','--','src','tests','pyproject.toml'],cwd=folder).split(b'\0')
    paths=sorted(set(p.decode() for p in rawpaths if p))
    actual=[{'path':p,'sha256':sha((folder/p).read_bytes())} for p in paths]
    assert actual==epoch['post'][name],name
    subprocess.run(['git','diff','--exit-code',commit,'--','src','tests','pyproject.toml'],cwd=folder,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-o','--exclude-standard','--','src','tests','pyproject.toml'],cwd=folder)==b''
    subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',commit,'HEAD'],cwd=folder,check=True)
    counts[name]=len(actual)
for item in canonical['changed_source_test_files']:
    assert sha(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',canonical['code_commit']+':'+item['path']],cwd=root))==item['sha256']
report=json.loads((root/canonical['root_validation']['path']).read_bytes())
for snapshot in report['static_audit']['snapshots']:
    raw=(root/snapshot['path']).read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw)==snapshot['sha256'] and len(raw)==snapshot['bytes'];ast.parse(raw)
    if 'baseline_source' in snapshot:
        assert raw==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',snapshot['baseline_commit']+':'+snapshot['baseline_source']],cwd=root)
for test in report['static_audit']['new_test_files']:
    raw=(root/test['path']).read_bytes();assert sha(raw)==test['sha256']
    items=[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(raw)) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
    assert len(items)==test['assert_count'] and sha(json.dumps(items,separators=(',',':')).encode())==test['assert_ast_sha256']
classification=canonical['case_classification']
assert sum(classification[k] for k in ['preceding_commit_public_behavior_failures','preceding_commit_controls','new_mechanisms','draft_behavior_failures','draft_controls'])==classification['total_new_cases']==60
assert all(canonical['verification'][group]['exit_code']==0 for group in ['core','pro','paired','new'])
print(json.dumps({'references_verified':len(canonical['references']),'source_test_files':counts,'all_pre_post_current_and_fixed_commit_equal':True,'changed_source_test_files':len(canonical['changed_source_test_files']),'complete_snapshots':len(report['static_audit']['snapshots']),'whole_v1_complete':False},indent=2))
